decisions.reason: Removing the requirement to place both products does not alter the independently specified realism and native-looking UGC visual criteria.

The source does not explicitly cancel or revise the established product benefits, diabetes indication, or claim-selection rules; removing both-product placement alone does not necessarily change those messaging facts.
The keyword and wording constraints remain semantically independent of whether both products must appear in the video.
The deferred landing-page and tracking audit is unrelated to product placement in the test ad.
